svg.text: E-A Spülzelle — the preparation cell is a dishwasher
Food is prepared inside a dishwasher tub. Tools hang inside and never leave; afterwards the door closes and the tub washes itself.
single tub 560 W × 480 D × 560 H (~150 L)
17 motion actuators + 3 pumps + 1 fan, all motors dry
full wash 17 L · 1.3 kWh · 45–55 min incl. drying
quick rinse: 20 s per tool in the jet gate
FRONT SECTION through the tub (door removed), 0.9 px per mm

How it cleans

g.text: Full wash after the meal (programme P1): 17 L, 1.3 kWh, 45–55 min
What gets wet: the whole tub (1.7 m²) and all ~18 tools (0.6 m²), every meal.
Dries by stored heat: 25 kg of tub steel at 80 °C can evaporate 230 g; film is ~70 g.
Peel and trimmings go to the floor, are flushed to the strainer, flipped into the bio bin.
Check: last-rinse turbidity + conductivity; camera with UV-A compares parked tools.
Weak point: even one onion soils the whole tub and blocks it for ~50 min.

svg.text: 1/7 Box docks above the shutter and tilts: potatoes drop into the basket inside the tub
2/7 Rod R1 (tongs) sets a potato on the turntable spike; rod R2 holds it from above with a cup
3/7 Turntable spins the potato; R1 draws a Y-peeler pole to pole; peel falls to the floor
4/7 Quick rinse: R1 turns the used peeler inside the jet gate (cold, 20 s) — no extra rack
5/7 Peeled potato into the exchange tray; the tray leaves through the side hatch to the hob
6/7 Door closes: spray arms wash tub and parked tools; rods sweep and stroke, turntable lifts and spins
7/7 80 °C rinse; strainer turns and dumps peel to the bio bin; vent fan, steel dries by its own heat
